originalAlarm.description: Branch condition evaluates to a garbage value

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: 'buf' is declared without initialization (char *buf at line 6). When the -n option is passed (cmd=8), 'goto all_done' at line 23 skips the malloc at line 26, jumping directly to the 'all_done:' label. When CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP is true, the code reaches 'if (buf)' at line 30 with buf uninitialized — the branch condition evaluates to a garbage value. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for eef2317b9f5.c documents exactly this UninitializedVariable bug (buf uninitialized when FEATURE_CLEAN_UP is enabled and -n is used, leading to free of uninitialized pointer). The tool detects the uninitialized branch condition that immediately precedes the erroneous free. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP==true is correct — the if(buf)/free(buf) code is inside the #ifdef block.
